$comment: Pinned third-party binaries. SHA256 values were taken from the GitHub release asset 'digest' field (api.github.com/repos/<repo>/releases/latest, queried 2026-11-13) AND re-computed locally with shasum -a 256 after download; both matched. Exceptions, each cross-checked against an independent source and recorded in that artifact's notes: vigembus-windows-installer (release is from 2023, GitHub has no digest for it; matched the winget-pkgs manifest) and vigemclient-windows-x64 (NuGet package; matched nuget.org's catalog SHA512). scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs downloads only these URLs (allow-list in the script) and refuses any file whose SHA256 differs; an artifact with an 'extracted' block also has the extracted file re-hashed.

artifacts.notes: Bundle id com.moonlight-stream.Moonlight, CFBundleShortVersionString 6.2.0, LSMinimumSystemVersion 13.0.0, notarized Developer ID (TeamIdentifier 45U78722YL), spctl: accepted.

Not downloaded on the Mac by default (only needed for the Windows build); scripts/build-windows.ps1 and scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs --windows fetch and verify it. GitHub auto-generated source archives have no published digest, so sourceSha256 is null; the source offer points at the tag + commit.

Downloaded on the Mac ONLY to confirm the install layout (sunshine.exe at root, tools\sunshinesvc.exe, scripts\install-service.bat ...). Not shipped: upstream says the lite build has reduced performance and no support.
Dev tool only (static check of *.ps1 via [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile). Never shipped. Verified running: $PSVersionTable.PSVersion = 7.7.0.

artifacts.extract: unzip into vendor/moonlight-windows/ (ditto -xk on macOS, tar -xf on Windows)
artifacts.notes: Official portable x64 build. SHA256 from the GitHub release asset digest field.

artifacts.arch: x64 (one installer for x64, x86 and arm64)
artifacts.extract: none (bundled as-is; installed silently by scripts/windows/install-vigembus.ps1 with: /exenoui /qn /norestart)
artifacts.binary: installs the kernel driver ViGEmBus.sys (service ViGEmBus, hardware id Nefarius\ViGEmBus\Gen1)
artifacts.notes: Upstream is archived (last release 2023-11-02) but is the standard virtual-gamepad driver. GitHub has no digest for this old release (digest: null), so the SHA256 was computed locally and matches InstallerSha256 in microsoft/winget-pkgs manifests/v/ViGEm/ViGEmBus/1.22.0 (ProductCode {9C581C76-2D68-40F8-AA6F-94D3C5215C05}, silent switches /exenoui /qn /norestart). Authenticode-signed by 'Nefarius Software Solutions e.U.' (DigiCert); built with Advanced Installer (setup/ViGEmBus.aip), not WiX. Not downloaded or run on the Mac.

artifacts.extract: unzip the nupkg; the managed lib/netstandard2.0/Nefarius.ViGEm.Client.dll embeds the native x86 and x64 ViGEmClient.dll as .NET resources (Costura); scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs reads the CLR resource area and writes the x64 one to vendor/vigemclient-windows-x64/ViGEmClient.dll
artifacts.binary: ViGEmClient.dll (PE32+ x64 DLL, 28 exports, imports only SETUPAPI.dll and KERNEL32.dll)
artifacts.notes: nefarius/ViGEmClient publishes no DLL release (only 2018 tags without assets and source), so this is the DLL inside the official, author-signed (Nefarius, DigiCert) NuGet package Nefarius.ViGEm.Client 1.21.256 (MIT). The nupkg SHA256 was computed locally; its SHA512 matches packageHash in the nuget.org catalog entry (catalog0/data/2023.02.05.02.02.24). The DLL's PE timestamp 2023-02-05T01:48:49Z and PDB path (C:\projects\vigemclient\bin\release\x64, AppVeyor) fit ViGEmClient commit 7e471cb (merge of PR #25, 2023-02-05T01:47:56Z), whose headers the TypeScript bindings were checked against. Not downloaded on the Mac by default.

devTools.notes: Dev-only static analysis, never shipped. The Gallery publishes no digest, so these hashes were recorded at first install (2026-11-13, trust on first use); check-ps.mjs refuses to load a module whose files differ.
